zh.v13.recoveryHint: 升级、导入、批量补录及修改计算规则前自动保留，最多5份。恢复会替换全部记录、模板、回收站、规则和锁定状态；恢复前也会保存当前副本。无法防止卸载、清除数据或手机丢失。

zh.v13.keep: 保留两条（时间不得重叠）

zh.v13.unlocked: 未锁定，可以继续录入和核对。
zh.v13.rulesConfirm: 修改后会重新计算汇总和报表，不改写原始时间。操作前保留恢复副本；有锁定周期时须先全部解锁。
zh.v13.recoverConfirm: 恢复将替换当前全部记录、模板、回收站、显示和计算规则以及周期锁定状态，并恢复副本中的提醒设置。当前状态会先保留为一份恢复副本。是否继续？

zh.v13.pending: 计入为0分钟的分段：{0}。请核对是否由取整造成。
zh.v13.checkHint: 请先与实际出勤或公司记录核对；点击锁定代表你已人工核对。跨周期记录涉及的任一周期锁定后，整条记录均不可修改。
zh.v13.lockConfirm: 锁定后将阻止新增、修改、删除、恢复或导入涉及本周期的记录。
zh.v13.unlockConfirm: 解锁后此周期的记录可再次修改。
zh.v13.mismatch: 界面与数据层合计不一致，已阻止锁定，请导出备份并检查。

en.rules.time: Raw net = end − start − break. Select next day for overnight work. Each entry is at most 24 hours and cannot overlap another. Entered wall-clock time is used, without daylight-saving adjustments.

en.rules.formats: JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) backups can restore entries. CSV (Comma-Separated Values) files are spreadsheets for viewing and cannot be imported to restore data.

en.v13.importHint: Choose how to handle matching IDs. Identical entries are always skipped; keeping both requires non-overlapping times. Time conflicts and locked periods are always skipped. Backup locks are not applied to merged data; review the merged periods again.
en.v13.importCounts: Added {0}, replaced {1}, duplicates {2}, time conflicts {3}, locked skipped {4}.
en.v13.first100: Only the first 100 items are shown; totals and import include all items.
en.v13.applyImportHint: Merge using the selected policy. A recovery copy is saved first. A failed import rolls back and retains existing data.
en.v13.locked: Reviewed and locked. Unlock before changing entries.
en.v13.unlocked: Unlocked. Entries can be added and reviewed.
en.v13.rulesConfirm: Summaries and reports will be recalculated; original times stay intact. A recovery copy is saved first. All locked periods must be unlocked.
en.v13.recoverConfirm: Restore replaces all current entries, templates, trash, appearance and calculation rules, period locks, and reminder settings. A copy of the current state will be saved first. Continue?
en.v13.pending: Segments credited as 0 minutes: {0}. Review rounding where applicable.
en.v13.checkHint: Check against actual attendance or company records. Locking confirms your manual review. An entry crossing periods cannot be changed if either affected period is locked.
en.v13.lockConfirm: Locking blocks adding, editing, deleting, restoring or importing entries affecting this period.
en.v13.unlockConfirm: Unlocking allows this period to be changed again.
en.v13.mismatch: UI and stored calculations disagree. Locking is blocked; export a backup and investigate.
